summary: Neo-Concept International Group Holdings filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its 2026 annual general meeting, originally convened September 28, 2026 but adjourned for lack of quorum to October 5, 2026 in Hong Kong. Holders of 566,643 ordinary shares carrying 4,626,643 votes attended, constituting a quorum out of 2,545,544 shares outstanding at the September 8 record date. All resolutions passed, including a special resolution adopting the Third Amended and Restated Memorandum and Articles of Association, furnished as Exhibit 99.1. This is a routine meeting notice with no special-situation transaction terms; no price, premium, or deal mechanics apply.
